app.publish.developer.endpointHelp: Send {authorization} to {accounts} and {posts}. Responses are JSON and keys are limited to 120 requests per minute.
app.publish.developer.webhooksIntro: Receive signed delivery events in your own system. Failed requests retry up to eight times.
app.publish.developer.keyLimit: Revoke an active key before creating another.
app.publish.developer.webhookLimit: Revoke an active endpoint before creating another.
app.publish.inbox.planIncludes: The unified inbox, per-account views, conversation status and supported replies are included with the $15 monthly Publish Plan.
app.editor.generation.separationPolicy: One quoted job separates owned MP3/WAV audio up to 120 seconds into vocals, drums, bass, other, guitar and piano. The flat quote covers the source limit. Sources are inspected before any debit.
app.editor.generation.devicePolicy: Device files upload only when you choose Generate. File type, ownership and duration are checked before credits are spent.
app.editor.generation.failedPolicy: Generation failed. Refunds follow the normal job policy. Edit the prompt and generate again, or retry from your Library.
app.publish.calendar.invalidTime: Choose a valid local time more than one minute from now. Daylight saving gaps are not valid times.
app.publish.calendar.targetsMove: . All targets move together. Publishing must not have started.
app.publish.calendar.cancelHelp: This prevents every untouched target from publishing. The post remains in your calendar so you can restore it later.
app.oddlings.referenceLimit: Keep the local reference under 2 MB.
app.oddlings.opensCreate: OPENS CREATE · NO CHARGE UNTIL CONFIRMED
app.editor.legacy.policy: Editing and export run in this browser and use no credits. Saving a project stores its timeline and settings in your workspace; files from this computer stay here. Keep this tab open during export. Preview and export share the same audio mix. Imported sources can be up to 10 minutes; this edit is up to 60 seconds.
app.create.feedbackIntro: Want prompt feedback? Studio skills cost 1 Credit a reply:
app.create.fixedOutputHelp: This model produces one fixed output length at the displayed price.
app.create.pricingUnavailable: Live prices are unavailable. You can browse models, but generation is paused so a cached quote can never be charged.
